from pathlib import Path
workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace')
prog=workspace/'programs'/'task-a868cea3.py'
prog.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = {7, 8}
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v in markers for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in markers for r in range(h))]
    # The marker-bearing rows and columns are the vertices of the encoded array.
    # The value of an output cell is its uniform corner color when all four
    # corners agree on 7 or 8; otherwise use the repeated cell fill color.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in markers)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]])
            if corners[0] in markers and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                line.append(corners[0])
            else:
                line.append(fill)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
prog.write_text(code)
print(prog)
